target_customer: AI labs training agents for creative tasks, starting with video editing
problem: An agent can output a valid video file without meeting the client brief. Labs need ways to measure creative quality and feed it back as reward and training data.
business_model: Private evaluations, RL environments and expert training data sold to AI labs
product_category: AI evals, RL environments and training data for creative work

founders.name: Pavan Kalyan Tankala
education: IIT Bombay, B.Tech and M.Tech in electrical engineering and AI
founders.background_notes: Published at NeurIPS, ACL and Interspeech per the YC page.

founders.name: Gunin Gupta
founders.background_notes: Listed as CBO on the company site and COO on the YC page.

competitors.name: Mercor, Surge, Handshake, Turing
competitors.what: Human data vendors that also sell RL environments
competitors.traction_then: over 75% of revenue sits with four firms per a 2026 summary

competitors.name: Mechanize, Fleet AI, HUD and similar

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a verifier calibrated on thousands of blind professional judgments, plus agent harnesses for video editing, needs ML research skill and expert labor coordination.

defensibility.rationale: Expert-calibrated verifier data could compound, but large data vendors can enter creative domains and labs can build in-house.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: In early 2026 Mercor and Handshake acquired evaluation and environment startups, showing incumbents buy into this space.

market_need_then: RL environments were described as a high-value backbone for training frontier models in 2025 and 2026 coverage, and creative tasks lacked reliable verifiers.

branding.domain_note: Uses tensortest.com; parent is Ritivel Labs Inc. with a ritivel.com email.

identity.visual_style: Dark theme, uppercase labels, numbered steps, monospace metadata
identity.voice_and_tone: Measure what AI can do in the real world

rebrands.why: Not stated; YC description says formerly Ritivel

branding.community_and_virality: TimelineBench paper listed at NeurIPS 2026 and on arXiv-style aggregators; the benchmark is the community touchpoint.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name plus a named benchmark with a paper helps credibility with labs, but similar names (Tensor, TensorZero, Tensor9) are common.

outcome_analysis: TensorTest, formerly Ritivel, joined YC in Winter 2026 with IIT Bombay and Microsoft Research India founders and published TimelineBench, a video editing benchmark, which gives it a research credibility signal. No outcome yet; the risks are dependence on a few AI lab buyers and competition from large data vendors.
notes: Dealroom shows a $125k seed with no investors or date; unverified, not recorded. Benchmark numbers differ by source (YC page says best agent passed 26.8%, site says 14.0% resolved; paper listings cite 56 or 100 tasks). Rename date not found. Founded year not sourced.
